page.overview:
Who is Headhunter?

{| class="wikitable" style="border-collapse:collapse;"

!style="border:1px solid black" colspan=2|Generation 1

Headhunters were introduced in the 1992 series of A Real American Hero toys, as part of the Drug Elimination Force subset. ---- Appearance: black helmet with gold faceplate; light blue shirt; black jacket with light brown spiked shoulder pad and gloves; black pants with light brown holster and boots

Accessories: rectangular black tech backpack with slot for shotgun; black shotgun with trigger guard and curved grip at rear; transparent purple, spring-loaded missile launcher; black missile with bomb-shaped tip. ---- YoJoe.com page/Filecard
